title: Completed reauthentication command receipt
description: The receipt both step-up commands return. Its four top-level keys are the merged receipt envelope every Console mutation carries; command-receipt.json cannot describe these because its response vocabulary is closed against widening, which is the defect ADR 0016 records.

status.description: A receipt reaches the customer only once its command has completed.

responseCode.description: One code per command, and each route pins the exact code it expects. UNSUPPORTED_SERVER_RESPONSE is the consumer's representation of a value it does not recognize; the backend never emits it. It is a member rather than a bare annotation so a later step-up command can be published additively.

responsePayload.description: The owning command's own result. `issueSessionReauthentication` returns challengeId, state, actionClass and expiresAt; `completeSessionReauthentication` returns challengeId and state. Neither interior is restated here, because it belongs to the command rather than to this envelope.
